title: Just Cast Charters
specs: Targets species including redfish, trout, snapper, shark, flounder, bull reds, kingfish, mahi-mahi, grouper, swordfish

No age minimum stated for children
Safe for all ages on shark fishing trips
Most boats accommodate up to 6 people; some bay trips limited to 3 or 4 people with additional person fees
